name: navigator-task-cadence-decision
body: The per-task cadence is: the implementer commits and returns; the coordinator quick-verifies, scans, then resumes the session to mark the task done. The binary staleness guard refuses every plan/review mutation unless the branch graph's recorded HEAD matches the working tree (same sha, clean); `rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh` holds the freshness test, `rust.apg.git.state.refusal_message` forms the refusal, and the mutation gate sits in `rust.apg.artifacts.db.write_jsonl_and_reingest` for the plan/review surface and `rust.apg.layers.write.write_project_with` for node/edge. A target-less task takes zero commit and zero scan; aggregates are ordered after their units, gates last. `requirements.requirement.navigator-task-cadence` drives `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence`, realised by `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` and implemented by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, which `contains` under `solution.container.opencode-suite`. The law `requirements.constraint.navigator-cadence-stated` governs the cadence ordering.
